attributes.context: Elsewhere in the same text, the agreement permits shop bending of steel trucks on BCANJ projects, requires job-site repairs of shop-bent steel by Ironworkers, and addresses transfer of foremen and journeymen as well as bid-stage requests for additional bent steel.

extraction_text: (G) Technology changes are constantly occurring in the manufacturing processes of producing building components which modify the composition (or gauge) of the materials used to achieve the final products but are still designed and manufactured to function the same products which are traditionally manufactured products in carbon steel, high strength steel or stainless steel. In these cases where new or modified material are replacing or substituting or working in conjunction with traditional metal sections, products or structural shapes typically installed by Ironworkers, the work of erecting or installing the modified product is the work of the Ironworker, without any exceptions.

attributes.context: The surrounding section concerns shop bending and job-site bending of reinforcement steel, with repairs to shop-bent steel to be performed by Ironworkers.

extraction_text: (F) Reinforcement bars on all jobs shall be bent on the job. On building construction jobs covered by this Agreement, reinforcement bars may be cut in the shop at the employer's option. An employer's utilization of a portable power bending machine on the job is optional and acceptable. However, it is permissible on all BCANJ projects the first steel truck may be shop bent. Effective July 1, 2001, it is permissible on all BCANJ projects that two steel trucks may be shop bent. Any repairs or alterations to shop bent steel, after delivery to the job site, will be performed at the job site by Ironworkers.
